claims.text: The starting material is a eutectic high-entropy alloy with hierarchical dual-phase lamellar colonies, such as FCC/B2.
The untreated starting material has limited room-temperature tensile ductility and is brittle.
Dislocation pile-ups near phase or internal boundaries cause local stress concentrations, early microcrack initiation, and catastrophic damage in the untreated alloy.
A controlled thermal anneal can selectively recrystallize the soft FCC phase.
The selective anneal can preserve the integrity of the hard ordered phase.
The proposed treatment will fully recrystallize the FCC lamellae while leaving intact hard-phase lamellae at their interfaces.
Phase-selective recrystallization will produce a more uniform dislocation distribution.
Selective FCC recrystallization eliminates stored dislocation networks.
Selective FCC recrystallization eliminates weak internal boundaries.
Eliminating stored dislocations and weak internal boundaries reduces dislocation pile-ups and associated local stress concentrations.
Reducing dislocation pile-ups and local stress concentrations suppresses microcrack formation.
The preserved hard ordered phase continues to provide high strength after treatment.
Comparable untreated alloys typically exhibit approximately 8–14% elongation.
The treatment may raise uniform elongation to approximately 35%.
The treatment will maintain or slightly increase both yield strength and ultimate tensile strength relative to the untreated material.
Cryo-rolling followed by annealing has simultaneously increased strength and elongation in nano-lamellar AlCoCrFeNi2.1 EHEA.
Annealing Al0.3CoFeNi at 700 °C can produce a more damage-tolerant FCC+B2 microstructure with about 900 MPa yield strength and greater than 20% tensile ductility.
The proposed treatment is intended for room-temperature tensile operation and testing.
The optimal annealing temperature and duration are not known and must be optimized to avoid detrimental coarsening.
Applicability to other alloy systems or non-room-temperature conditions is unverified.
